g.text: Jack detects, faceplate detect and spares, eFuse faults

g.desc: Jack detects, faceplate detect and spares, eFuse faults

g.text: 1. Function: TCA6416A, the slow enables and detects (pinout v1 expander table); VCCI on

g.desc: 1. Function: TCA6416A, the slow enables and detects (pinout v1 expander table); VCCI on

g.text: vcca1v8_pmu, VCCP on vcc3v3_sys; outputs hold through suspend.

g.desc: vcca1v8_pmu, VCCP on vcc3v3_sys; outputs hold through suspend.

g.text: 2. Absent state: never omitted. At power-up every port is an input: P02-P04 pulled down here;

g.desc: 2. Absent state: never omitted. At power-up every port is an input: P02-P04 pulled down here;

g.desc: P00 on blk.fp-connector, P01 on blk.hat-5v, P06, P07 on blk.radio.

g.text: 3. ADDR to VCCP: address 0x21 (SCPS194F). RESET 10 kΩ to VCCI (not driven by the SoC).
